content.text: The name of this avatar base is
Kajos are a species similar to fluffy
. Kajos come from a planet far away and are named after its glowing details and the time of day they are most active on (dawn).
More details on the UwU Version can be found here:
Substance Painter version 9.1.2 (Latest 2023 version) or newer required
Kajo has multiple customization options available.
Everything is implemented using VRCFury, so any feature can be
any features by dragging and dropping them into the avatar.
Including wings, different fur, hair, horns, and more!
Kajo comes with various clothing and accessories by default!
I do not provide any of the following dependencies, and it is your responsibility to download and install them.
Unity 2022.3.22f1 and the knowledge of uploading the avatar to VRChat
